title: Class Player
Fibonacci Loop
code:
a, b = 0, 1
seq = []
for _ in range(8):
    seq.append(a)
    a, b = b, a + b
print(seq)

title: Safe Division
Unique Preserve Order
code:
items = [1, 2, 1, 3, 2, 4]
seen = set()
out = []
for x in items:
    if x not in seen:
        seen.add(x)
        out.append(x)
print(out)
